slots.name: lab members
slots.sentence: The special treatment shown to TBD hires, some of whom had pay packages in the hundreds of millions of dollars, created resentment among some employees who weren’t asked to join the lab or given similar pay packages last fall. TBD’s work is closely guarded, the area where they sit required special badge access for entry and the names of its members, which now number roughly 200, aren’t visible on the company’s internal organizational chart.
